text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hurry, everyone, hurry! We gotta go to that super popular cafe and lock on to some of their coffee jellies for grown-ups!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No, let's go to the toy store, the toy
store! I know
you're all going to love the
stuff on sale there,
like Carrot Ranger's
awesome ride!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you two are such children. Don't
you have
even a sliver of interest in the
dark arts like I do?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okay, calm down everyone, calm down.
Be
patient and we'll go everywhere
you'd like to go.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Remember, you mustn't run, okay?
Umamusume
can reach considerable
speeds, even when we're
just jogging.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: S-sorryyy...
choice_data_list_en: There are a lot of people here, too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sooorry...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm so proud of you for reflecting
on your
actions. ♪ You're such good
kids. ♪ There,
there. ♪

text_block_list.name: The Three "Kids"
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm out shopping in a group of
five.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We all bumped into each other at the
academy
and, after learning we were
headed to the same
place, decided to
spend the day together.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Let's go to the toy store
first! You
know how epic heroes are,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, the cafe comes first! You understand
its
mature appeal, don't you?! Let's
touch down at
the cafe for some coffee
jelly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko and Mayano pull my arms in
opposite
directions, like spoiled children
nagging their
parent.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're awfully popular. So, where
shall we
go first?
choice_data_list: ちゃ、ちゃんとどっちも行くから！

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Carrot Ranger's new weapon is
already
out?! I'm so glad we came here!
choice_data_list_en: Have fun at the toy store!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what a cute hand mirror! I had no
idea they
sold stuff like this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Such children! I can't believe
you're
making such a fuss over a bunch
of toys!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her protests, Sweep Tosho's
eyes are
locked onto a certain display as
she speaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neatly arranged on the display is a
selection of
magical girl wands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to distract Sweep Tosho, I
glance at
Super Creek, who gives a small
nod in response.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Would you like one of those wands,
Sweep?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What?! N-no! I don't need something
like that!
They're for children!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: They are very cute, but they're also quite cool, don't you think? I think I might like one myself, actually.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Even you like them, Creek?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: 2人とも、ステッキ買ってきたよ！
choice_data_list_en: I bought canes for both of you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-well since you already bought them, I
guess I'll
take one off your hands. Not
that I want one of
these or anything...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, that's no fair, Sweep! What
about me? I
want this beautiful,
grown-up hand mirror!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want something, too! Carrot Ranger's
new
weapon is the coolest, I can't stand
it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I soon find myself noticeably poorer,
but it feels
quite nice somehow.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you ever so much for today,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Bleugh.
choice_data_list_en: I had a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The mature coffee jelly that Mayano
Top Gun
had her heart set on tastes far
more bitter than
she expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After tasting the bitter coffee jelly, the
three
Umamusume feel suddenly
deflated...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this coffee jelly is simply
delicious. I almost
want to eat all of
yours, too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hm, but then the three of you would all
miss out
on having dessert.
choice_data_list: お、俺ももっと欲しいなぁ！
わ、私ももっと欲しいなぁ！

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess I'll just have to buy new
desserts for
all of you. Which would you
like?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's my thanks for all this tasty coffee
jelly you've
given me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Awesome!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-I guess if you insist! Here, you can have
my
coffee jelly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we successfully protect their
taste buds
from a bitter reckoning.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you ever so much for today,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it really was an enjoyable day.
choice_data_list_en: I had a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so excited and talkative...
It was
almost like we were a real family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If those three little rascals are the unruly

children... then that would make me and
Super
Creek their—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Creek! Trainer! What are you two doing?
You're
gonna get left behind!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, we should hurry. Let's not keep our children waiting. Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Come along, Daddy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Come along, Mommy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm just kidding. ♪
